metaDescription: Total Brantford Concrete won our 2026 Concrete Finishing & Pouring award for Brantford, Ontario. Driveways, patios and stamped work since 2016.
summary: Total Brantford Concrete pours and finishes driveways, stamped patios, walkways and steps for homeowners across Brantford, Paris, Cambridge, Hamilton and Brant County. With over 10 years of experience, the company builds every quote around a free on-site estimate and a written warranty.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Total Brantford Concrete offers concrete driveways, patios and walkways, steps and porches, stamped and decorative concrete, concrete sealing and maintenance, and concrete repair and resurfacing. Covering both new pours and ongoing sealing and repair means the company can maintain a driveway or patio for years after the original install.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company engineers its concrete work specifically for Ontario's freeze-thaw winters, a real durability concern for exterior concrete in this climate. Every project comes with a free on-site estimate, permit handling where required, and a written warranty, which is worth reading in full for what it covers and for how long.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer described redoing their driveway as a night-and-day difference, praising a crew that stayed polite, cleaned up daily, and finished ahead of schedule. Another said the company provided a clear quote and stuck to it, and that their stamped concrete patio looked like natural stone at a more affordable price, becoming their preferred spot to host guests.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves Brantford, Paris, Cambridge, Hamilton, Caledonia and Brant County, covering a wide portion of Southwestern Ontario beyond Brantford proper. Confirm coverage if your address falls outside these named areas.

strengths: Over 10 years of experience specifically in concrete driveways, patios and decorative work.
Every project includes a free on-site estimate and a written warranty.
Handles permit requirements as part of the project, reducing homeowner administrative work.
Reviews specifically mention crews staying on schedule and cleaning up daily, a common pain point on concrete jobs.
Also offers sealing and repair, not just new pours, for long-term maintenance of existing concrete.
considerations: Concrete pouring is weather- and temperature-dependent, so expect scheduling to concentrate in warmer months.
Best suited to standard residential concrete projects; ask directly about capacity for larger commercial pours.
Not a fit if you need a same-week emergency repair; concrete curing times require realistic project scheduling.
Stamped and decorative concrete costs more than a plain broom-finish driveway, so ask for a side-by-side price comparison.
bestFor: Homeowners replacing an aging or cracked concrete driveway
Anyone planning a stamped concrete patio for entertaining
Properties needing steps, porches or walkways poured alongside a driveway
Homeowners wanting ongoing sealing and repair after the original pour
questionsToAsk: What does the free on-site estimate include, and how firm is the resulting written quote?
What does the written warranty cover, and for how long?
How do you handle site prep and drainage to protect against freeze-thaw cracking?
For stamped concrete, what pattern and colour options are available, and how do they affect price?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Total Brantford Concrete was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top concrete finishing and pouring contractor serving Brantford, Ontario, based on public services, reviews and business practices, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: Do they offer a written warranty?
faq.a: Yes, the company states every project comes with a written warranty in addition to a free on-site estimate.
Brantford, Paris, Cambridge, Hamilton, Caledonia and Brant County.

faq.q: Do they handle permits for concrete work?
faq.a: The company's description states it handles permit requirements as part of its process, though homeowners should confirm this applies to their specific project.
